meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 它会清掉你分支改动(或你指定的文件)里的 AI 代码味,包括废话注释、过度防御、死代码等九类。动手前先用回归测试锁住现有行为,再分步清理并过质量门校验,不通过就回退。
howto.when: 当你说要清理、去味(deslop)或移除最近改动里的 AI-slop 时触发;不带参数时默认处理分支相对 main 的 diff。

say.text: 帮我把当前分支改动里的 AI 代码味清理掉
say.note: 默认范围是分支相对 main 的 diff

say.text: 清理这几个文件里的 AI slop:src/foo.py、src/bar.py
say.note: 范围变成你给出的文件清单

say.text: 先确认测试是绿的,再清理 src/foo.py 里的 AI 代码味
say.note: 测试不绿会停下,不做清理

howto.what_en: It removes AI-generated slop from branch changes or a named file list: obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code. Regression tests pin behavior first, then passes clean it; quality gates check it, and it reverts on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes; with no arguments it defaults to the branch diff against main.

say_en.text: Clean the AI slop out of my current branch changes
say_en.note: Default scope is the branch diff vs main
Scope becomes that explicit file list

say_en.text: Lock behavior with regression tests first, then deslop src/foo.py
say_en.note: Tests must be green before any cleanup
